get.summary: Get interaction restrictions for an organization
get.desc: Shows which type of GitHub user can interact with this organization and when the restriction expires. If there is no restrictions, you will see an empty response.

params.name: org
params.desc: The organization name. The name is not case sensitive.

put.summary: Set interaction restrictions for an organization
put.desc: Temporarily restricts interactions to a certain type of GitHub user in any public repository in the given organization. You must be an organization owner to set these restrictions. Setting the interaction limit at the organization level will overwrite any interaction limits that are set for individual repositories owned by the organization.

params.name: org
params.desc: The organization name. The name is not case sensitive.

application/json.title: Interaction Restrictions
application/json.description: Limit interactions to a specific type of user for a specified duration

limit.description: The type of GitHub user that can comment, open issues, or create pull requests while the interaction limit is in effect.

expiry.description: The duration of the interaction restriction. Default: `one_day`.

delete.summary: Remove interaction restrictions for an organization
delete.desc: Removes all interaction restrictions from public repositories in the given organization. You must be an organization owner to remove restrictions.

params.name: org
params.desc: The organization name. The name is not case sensitive.

get.summary: Get interaction restrictions for a repository
get.desc: Shows which type of GitHub user can interact with this repository and when the restriction expires. If there are no restrictions, you will see an empty response.

params.name: owner
params.desc: The account owner of the repository. The name is not case sensitive.

params.name: repo
params.desc: The name of the repository without the `.git` extension. The name is not case sensitive.

put.summary: Set interaction restrictions for a repository
put.desc: Temporarily restricts interactions to a certain type of GitHub user within the given repository. You must have owner or admin access to set these restrictions. If an interaction limit is set for the user or organization that owns this repository, you will receive a `409 Conflict` response and will not be able to use this endpoint to change the interaction limit for a single repository.

params.name: owner
params.desc: The account owner of the repository. The name is not case sensitive.

params.name: repo
params.desc: The name of the repository without the `.git` extension. The name is not case sensitive.

application/json.title: Interaction Restrictions
application/json.description: Limit interactions to a specific type of user for a specified duration

limit.description: The type of GitHub user that can comment, open issues, or create pull requests while the interaction limit is in effect.

expiry.description: The duration of the interaction restriction. Default: `one_day`.

delete.summary: Remove interaction restrictions for a repository
delete.desc: Removes all interaction restrictions from the given repository. You must have owner or admin access to remove restrictions. If the interaction limit is set for the user or organization that owns this repository, you will receive a `409 Conflict` response and will not be able to use this endpoint to change the interaction limit for a single repository.

params.name: owner
params.desc: The account owner of the repository. The name is not case sensitive.

params.name: repo
params.desc: The name of the repository without the `.git` extension. The name is not case sensitive.

get.summary: Get interaction restrictions for your public repositories
get.desc: Shows which type of GitHub user can interact with your public repositories and when the restriction expires.

put.summary: Set interaction restrictions for your public repositories
put.desc: Temporarily restricts which type of GitHub user can interact with your public repositories. Setting the interaction limit at the user level will overwrite any interaction limits that are set for individual repositories owned by the user.

application/json.title: Interaction Restrictions
application/json.description: Limit interactions to a specific type of user for a specified duration

limit.description: The type of GitHub user that can comment, open issues, or create pull requests while the interaction limit is in effect.

expiry.description: The duration of the interaction restriction. Default: `one_day`.

delete.summary: Remove interaction restrictions from your public repositories
delete.desc: Removes any interaction restrictions from your public repositories.
